note: The root assembly of the OSCAL 1.2.1 plan-of-action-and-milestones model. It carries observations and findings as sibling arrays, so assessment results is not the only model in which an outcome can be recorded. Both models sit in the Assessment layer; no control-layer or implementation-layer model carries either.
constraints: observations items ref the shared assessment-common observation
findings items ref the shared assessment-common finding
fragment_note: Only required and the observations, findings and risks properties are carried.
